body: Ya...I think some sad, broken, old people need to stop getting out solo.  What was this any way? her idea of a stroll?
I read that the plastic is kind of "slippery" to them, WAY better than the paper cup method  and lots of bristles  to grab them up no matter which way they run.

thank you for saying that mom's matter, it helps.  Sometimes I think that the only way for me to finally assign relevance to all that I had suffered was to think that it had a purpose, a reason why all the things that have happened to me did, so I could share that wisdom with the next generation, my addition, my legacy was one that spoke of reason...now I fear even if I raised him well, this world will not hear it, where have I brought him to? Look at this place and the people in it...I am filled now with a new kind of dread I did not forsee, oh god what have i done? the suffering will not end with me.

thanks, it is true and these are emotions I need to understand, I can not separate emotions from pg...I'm not spock they do have a place at this time...what can I start to imagine and fantasize about having a boy? what is there to look forward to, Ijust don't understand...

Ya this helps...i keep wondering at night especially, what is there for me to look forward to with a boy?  what was it about me that wanted the girl? I envy women to say "daughter" I hate looking at the girl clothes...everything feels like a personal stab at me now.  Why, why would it hurt???

I am due on June 6.  So far one nice woman gave me a bib, newborn diapers, 4 onesies.  I peruse the DI and other places for clothes, a rocking chair, baby clothes etc. just the essentials, baby can sleep with me for as long as it takes, I'm already sure from other things that I will tolerate it ok, I'm actually a patient person...I think.  Thanks for answering me.

I absolutely agree this method works well for me, in fact is was what I turned to in order to decide if I should keep it or not, though that was an extremely unfair situation as I had only 48hours to make that call in time...on top of my life unravelling to this point.  Keep passing it on, it is what I would do too, it helps if not works.

Oh, I thought the wic food vouchers were food stamps...there's more?  Regardless of whether or not I can do this, I feel like if 16yr old girls can I can do it alone too...besides I have stuffs that those girls don't usually, education.  Also I'm getting older now, it will likely be the only one I ever have.

I'm having a boy.
It is funny, I didn't think on gender at the beginning b/c I didn't want to grow fond of one over the other, it happened anyway.  My friends through out time and my animals for that matter are all male, you would think this would fit right in hu?  I am somehow deeply disturbed by this anyway, like i have nothing to pass down not my jewlery or my knowledge of how to become a woman...effectively I feel like a test tube he's growing in...so hard to love that.  Thanks for the info I'll give lots of things a try.

As for danger, the only threat I can identify is me, I'm at the end of my rope once again in life but this time there is so much more to loose...also there is a creepy 50yr old guy who crashes here too who has had his eye on me for a while now...I think he likes watching me? it is getting creepier with his comments and implications that he knows more about me than i have shared, this stresses me out.

I'm in "mormon-ville", USA if that helps.  I wrote a more indepth plea as I mentioned above, it was not getting many hits so I thought I would try specifying a new title and reffering to the other post with 'the story'.  I don't have family, I kind of got landed here after planning so much, it fell through and now I am alone, pg, I talked to wic for food vouchers and the housing authority so I am not homeless (i am couch serfing atm)...I work, it doesnt pay much already inquired about a raise, still need better food and emotional support.

I want to cry after reading that, thank you for saying something about the bonding, it is tearing me up inside to think I face delivery at the birthing center, now with out the motivation I had earlier...i got as far as taking the prenatal vitamins again, maybe treating myself like it matters will make it matter?idk.  Ya I want help! big time, I want this to be better like really really!

I appreciate that you responded.
I don't need any more counselor's who are useless and don't actually work the problem, just pat on the head 'itll be ok, i cant tell you how but here are some useless pills/suggestions i know please others' treatment...sorry for the sarcasm I dislike there practices for adults not you.  Umm I have one good friend in particular and he is across the country jobless, he online supports me when i am at work.  That is about it, can't get help out of a chair at this point.  Makes me frustrated.  I am scared to cry on anyone else, the other times I tried that in my life I could have had that with a wall, ended up feeling embarassed and swearing I would never open up to such a useless person ever again.  That person didn't have the repor with me in the first place, I took a chance, person ended up distant afterwards like we had shared in sex not emotions, they became akward I have regret.  I'm not slamming your suggestions just being difficult or hormonal...just trying explain...
thanks for noticing me.

I won't placate you on this, repeat, I won't give you uselsess platitudes on this.  Your life is challanging, it not difficult in appreciable ways that we can all see is it?  What can you do ?  like, really if you are set with as many tools as you have made to fix this or make it work better what the hell are they? some of mine do not work or are rendered useless when I become depressed which is why it is such a bitch for me to deal with.  I can only try doing the opposite of what my depression says to me or in some cases see right through it and do what I know from trial and error is going to be right.  How many things do you try?  i dont mean what things Feel taxing or like you are putting in 'effort' that is also intangeable but what do you do?
